_about: Binary interaction parameters. NRTL: tau_ij = a_ij + b_ij/T, G_ij = exp(-alpha tau_ij). UNIQUAC: tau_ij = exp(a_ij + b_ij/T). T in K.

No open finite-concentration VLE data was found for this pair. liquid-liquid: AAD 0.0009 in x of water in the water-rich liquid, 0.0292 in the ethyl-acetate-rich liquid; gamma at infinite dilution: AARD 4.3 % (max 15.5 %); heterogeneous azeotrope at 101.325 kPa: 70.61 degC, vapour x of water 0.313, liquids 0.989 / 0.203 (target 70.40 degC, 0.301). Check against water_ethyl-acetate_lle_xu2017.json: liquid-liquid: AAD 0.0034 in x of water in the water-rich liquid. Temperature range of the data: 273.35-343.55 K; outside it the parameters are extrapolated.

Fitted (NRTL with alpha 0.2: with 0.3 the fitted set predicts a spurious third liquid at 270-340 K) to mutual solubilities: water in cyclohexane at 303-446 K (Marche, Ferronato, de Hemptinne, Jose, J. Chem. Eng. Data 51 (2006) 355), cyclohexane in water at 343-424 K and 1700 kPa (Marche, Delepine, Ferronato, Jose, J. Chem. Eng. Data 48 (2003) 398) and both at 295 K (Danon, Kroon, Banat, J. Chem. Eng. Data 63 (2018) 1123), all data public in the NIST TRC ThermoML Archive (validation/data/water_cyclohexane_lle_*.json); checked against the heterogeneous azeotrope at 101.325 kPa, 69.8 degC and 91.5 wt % cyclohexane (CRC Handbook 44th ed., via Wikipedia 'Azeotrope tables'). liquid-liquid: AAD 0.0000 in x of water in the water-rich liquid, 0.0004 in the cyclohexane-rich liquid; mole fraction of the dissolved (minor) component: AARD 20 % in the water-rich liquid (6 points, max 30 %), 14 % in the cyclohexane-rich liquid (8 points, max 39 %). Check against water_cyclohexane_azeotrope_101kPa.json: heterogeneous azeotrope at 101.325 kPa: 69.37 degC, vapour x of water 0.300, liquids 1.000 / 0.002 (target 69.80 degC, 0.303). Temperature range of the data: 295.0-446.15 K; outside it the parameters are extrapolated.

Searched: NIST TRC ThermoML Archive (ternary sets with water only: Gomis et al., Fluid Phase Equilib. 235 (2005) 7; Antosik et al., J. Chem. Eng. Data 49 (2004) 7; Cui et al., J. Chem. Eng. Data 49 (2004) 212), Crossref, open repositories. Open checks: the 1-atm azeotrope (64.9 degC, 69.5 wt % cyclohexane; validation/data/ethanol_cyclohexane_azeotrope_101kPa.json) and the excess enthalpy at 323.15 K, one liquid over the whole range (Lien et al., J. Chem. Eng. Data 48 (2003) 359; validation/data/ethanol_cyclohexane_HE_lien2003.json). A fit to these two alone predicts two liquids at 323 K, against the second; NRTL: the databank set passes both checks but predicts two liquids below about 315 K, not checked against data; UNIQUAC: the databank set predicts two liquids at 323-338 K (src/data/known-issues.json)
